title: VTC: derive E2EE call media keys from the room's MLS group (exporter)
description: From mimid work 2026-11-21 (Mark: file it). For a call started from a MIMI room, derive SFrame (RFC 9605) media keys from the room's MLS group via the MLS exporter, so the join endpoint never carries a secret and membership changes rekey the call. Nothing in MIMI or draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 defines this binding; candidate for a VTC draft section or a small companion draft.
